mapper.select: SELECT pay05_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id, pay05_appr_id AS appr_id, b.apr01_status_cd AS status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, pay05_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS status_name FROM pay05_relate_appr LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON pay05_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE pay05_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay05_pay_cd = '03' AND pay05_retire_id = #{monthId} AND pay05_start_date = ( SELECT pay10_date FROM pay10_month WHERE pay10_month_id = #{monthId} AND pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_pay_cd = '03' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay05_relate_appr (pay05_relate_appr_id, pay05_company_id, pay05_start_date, pay05_pay_cd) VALUES (#{relateApprId}, #{companyId}, #{payDate}, #{payCode})
mapper.select: SELECT pay05_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id, pay05_pay_cd AS pay_code, pay05_start_date AS start_date, (to_char(pay05_start_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')||' / '||f_cdnm('PayMonthCode', pay05_pay_cd, pay05_company_id, f_sysdate())) AS pay_group_name FROM pay05_relate_appr WHERE pay05_relate_appr_id = #{relateApprId} AND pay05_company_id = #{companyId}
